subject: GRW / objective-collapse theories (including CSL and gravitational variants)

twelve_questions.1_physically_real: Universal wavefunction + spontaneous collapse events (flashes or mass-density). Additional ontology beyond baseline.
twelve_questions.2_primitive_variables: Wavefunction + collapse dynamics. Variants add mass-density ontology (GRW-m) or flash ontology (GRW-f).
twelve_questions.3_fundamental_dynamics: Unitary evolution + stochastic collapse process. MODIFIED dynamics - explicitly outside Cbp (Door D1).
twelve_questions.4_probabilities_from: Collapse rates enter as explicit stochastic process parameters. Born-like statistics emerge statistically for macroscopic apparatus (mass-density amplification). The probabilistic character is itself POSTULATED as part of the stochastic law.
twelve_questions.5_definite_outcomes: YES - collapse dynamically selects one outcome. This is exactly what Cbp could not supply (Experiment P + hostile replication).
twelve_questions.6_recovers_unitary_sector: Recoverable in limit collapse rate -> 0 (lambda -> 0). Delta-function vs continuous CSL variants differ here.
twelve_questions.7_recovers_classicality: YES - collapse mechanism plus decoherence; pointer states selected by collapse noise structure (mass-density operator).
twelve_questions.8_additional_inputs_beyond_Cbp: MODIFIED DYNAMICS (D1 door): collapse rate lambda (~10^-16 s^-1 for GRW, per Bassi & Ghirardi Phys Rep 379, 257 (2003)); localization width sigma (~10^-7 m GRW); CSL continuous noise field. These are ADDITIONAL FREE PARAMETERS.
twelve_questions.9_empirical_inputs: lambda, sigma (GRW); CSL rate and correlation length. Currently constrained but not determined by experiment.
twelve_questions.10_novel_predictions: YES. Spontaneous heating of isolated systems (dE/dt = (lambda*2/3)*(m/m0)^2 * hbar^2/(m0*sigma^2), Bassi & Ghirardi 2003); bounds from neutron star heating (Tilloy & Derakhshani? see Collett et al. Nature Phys 15, 370 (2019) X-ray constraints on CSL), matter-wave interferometry exclusion regions, LISA Pathfinder seismic bounds (Carlesso et al. PRL 119, 231101 (2017)). These are genuine discriminating predictions vs standard QM (H2 candidate).
twelve_questions.11_falsification: YES - parameter space is progressively excluded by X-ray heating limits (Collett et al. 2019 rule out parameter ranges of CSL/GRW), interferometry exclusions (Nimmrichter et al. PRL 107, 250403 (2011) constrain CSL parameters), LISA Pathfinder (Carlesso 2017), spontaneous X-ray emission experiments (Curceanu et al.).
twelve_questions.12_unexplained_remainder: Free parameters not derived. Relativity-generalization problem UNRESOLVED (Tumulka flash relativistic GRW exists but full QFT version not complete). Statistical Born-rule: still postulated within the stochastic law, not derived from it.

scoring.compression: gain = 1 + 0.5 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4.5; cost = 1 + (0 or 1) + 1 + 2 + 1 + 0 + 1 + 1 = 7-8. compression ~ 0.56-0.64. Lower than Everett but GAIN IS GENUINE DYNAMICAL SELECTION (not reframed).

hypothesis_test: H1 CONFIRMED - genuinely escapes Cbp obstruction by altering dynamics (Door D1). H2 CONFIRMED - testable discriminating predictions. No semantic reinterpretation required.
